notes.title: Fixing a Fix patch
notes.notes:
While trying to fix potions and consumables being used right after closing a dialog, we introduced a delay in the usage of potions! So it's not that they were not working after the last patch, it's just that we changed how they work: instead of just clicking or pressing a key/button, you had to hold. 

But we understand that's confusing, so we found another solution that doesn't change the way potions work.

To sum it up:
- Closing a dialog won't trigger potion usage
- Using a potion works the same way it has always worked

Thank you for your patience!

And thank you to everyone who has provided feedback, suggestions and left reviews. It's been incredibly helpful for us! Please join our discord! We'd love to hear from you

notes.title: Blue Oak Bridge Full Release
notes.notes:
Blue Oak Bridge is now fully released! We want to thank each and every one of you for all the love and support the last three and a half years. Your dedication and help is what made Blue Oak Bridge what it is today. We hope you love it as much as we loved creating it for you!

We want to note that we plan to continue to work on, add to and update the game after releasing to make this the best game it can be. However, we will not be posting updates as frequently as we have in the past. 

Our amazing community has made this process so enjoyable and worth all the extra hours and late nights. Again, thank you for joining us every step of the way. We couldn’t have done it without you!

The Blue Oak Bridge Team 💙

notes.title: Patch Time! Finally!
notes.notes:
It's Patch Time! Finally 💙 

Over the last several weeks, we have spent a lot of time cleaning up small bugs, QOL changes and friendship quest cleanup. There are about 150 quests in the game and so many different ways to play them, as well as so many different ways to break them. It takes a good amount of time to thoroughly test them all, and we still have more clean up to do, but thank you for being patient while we,ve focused on these!

New Additions: 
 
- Shipping bin to sell things from your farm (new reward for selling 10,000 crowns worth of items to Alonzo) 
- Insta Harvest Potion (new reward for completing Cafe quest)
- Endless Water Potion (new reward for completing 70% Plant Life Compendium)

- Health bar shown for monster

- New Dalmatian model

We are just a few days shy of being in Early Access for two months! In these last 8 weeks, we've been able to make many changes, improvements and bug fixes from all of your help and suggestions. Thank you so much for going on this journey with us! 💙

notes.title: Mouse Support Patch
notes.notes:
💙Mouse Support💙 

Additions:

- Mouse support is now available! As this is still a work in progress, there may be a screen or two where the mouse is not available yet. We would love to continue to hear your feedback and suggestions to continue to make this better.

Fixes: 

- Marcelo, the blacksmith, now sells stone tools for anyone that may have lost their tools.
- Items disappearing from hotbar. We hope that won't happen again, but if it does please tell us, because it's a bug we can't reproduce!

Work in Progress:

- Keybinding
- We will continue to add more visual feedback so there is less confusion with what keys to use / what to do
- Correcting  quality ranked items not working food recipes
- Shrinking the HUD down
- Many more small things here and there

Again, all your amazing, kind help is greatly appreciated and we couldn't do it without you! We hope everyone has a great weekend, the Blue Oak Bridge Team 💙

Hi everyone! Here is the latest patch report:

In progress:

- A few people have reported losing their tools. We are reworking the blacksmith's shop so tools can be recovered and upgraded
- Keybinding

the Blue Oak Bridge Team 💙

Hello all!
